rationale: Alon is building dexterous manipulation technology for humanoid robots using learning-based approaches, and Kyo brings deep AI research and robotics expertise from Serious AI with a strong technical foundation in computer vision, SLAM, and languages like Python and C++. Their domains directly overlap on robotics, and Kyo's ML research and vision background could be valuable for accelerating Aora's learning-from-demonstrations approach to complex manipulation tasks.
intro_message: Alon Ko, meet Kyo Mangold — Kyo's AI research and computer vision expertise at Serious AI could complement your work on learning-based dexterous manipulation for humanoid robots.
